title: HeaderHound fingerprint entry
description: A single detection rule that identifies a cold-outreach / sales-engagement sending platform from an email's headers.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique across the list.

category.description: What kind of tool this is. cold-email-platform = built for bulk cold outreach; sales-engagement = SDR sequencing suites; mail-merge = Gmail mass-send tools; deliverability-warmup = inbox-warming services.

confidence.description: How strongly a match implies the platform. high = distinctive header/domain unlikely to appear otherwise; medium = plausible incidental matches exist; low = weak/heuristic.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression, matched against the region named by `scope`. Stored as a string; consumers compile it (e.g. new RegExp(pattern, 'i')).

scope.description: Where to apply the pattern. headers = the full header block; received = only Received: lines; body = message body (use sparingly, higher false-positive risk).

field.description: Optional. If set, apply the pattern only to this specific header field (e.g. 'X-Mailer'), reducing false positives.

notes.description: Why this fingerprint works / what the tell is.

references.description: Links to the vendor or to evidence of the fingerprint.

lastVerified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the fingerprint was last confirmed against a real sample. Stale entries should be re-checked.
